step.action: Confirm that 📋 Shut_down_flame_effects passed and every effect-feed valve is closed.
Wait the validated tank-reflow time printed in 🔥 Flame_Effect_Operating_Procedure.
Close the liquid-tank valve identified in the approved procedure.
Clear the vaporizer propane output using the approved procedure.
Discharge remaining propane from every accumulator through its approved effect path.
Close every regulator and remaining valve in the approved shutdown order.
Set vaporizer power to the shutdown state printed in the approved procedure.

passWhen.criterion: The liquid-tank valve, effect valves, safety valves, and regulators are closed.
The vaporizer output and every accumulator are cleared by the approved route.
Vaporizer power is in its approved shutdown state.

reasoning.entry: The workbook's five-minute reflow and ambiguous voltage decision require validation on the actual Zimmer; the approved operating procedure owns the final values.
